youtube.aciklama: In a purely illustrative audiogram of an eight-year-old child after cisplatin treatment, thresholds are 30 dB HL at 3000 Hz and 45 dB HL at 4000 Hz. The same audiogram is grade 2 on the Brock scale, 2a on the Chang scale and grade 3 on the SIOP Boston scale; so the grade is always reported with the scale name, and treatment decisions belong to the team.
